claim: *DocAble from the user's view.* An inaccessible document goes in; a remediated document and evidence of consequential changes come back. Internal structure is omitted because it is not yet relevant.

topology.description: Black-box transformation with document input and remediated document plus evidence output.

bw_encoding: White documents, image regions, system box and evidence pill; dark badges have white warning/check symbols.
redesign: Retain document pictograms, text bars, folded corners, warning/check badges, dashed/solid image panels, and external accessibility annotations. Return label is centered above its arrow between the system and output. Bottom headings are 11 pt bold and explanations 11 pt italic; relation labels and status pills are 10.5 pt. The redundant bottom note is removed. Native size is 449.333 by 179.711 bp, below the color original at 450 by 180.841 bp.
alt: An inaccessible document enters the closed DocAble production-system box. The output is an accessible document with described images, reading order and tags, accompanied by an evidence record explaining each fix. The black-box view shows what the system does without exposing its internals. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings. Input and output are page pictograms with warning and check badges; annotations below explain accessibility status, while dashed and solid image panels distinguish undescribed from described images.
